Rates and calculation

OpenAI uses Standard short-context rates verified October 20, 2026. Claude uses published Anthropic API rates, including 5-minute cache writes. Its verification date is recorded per run. Claude cache writes use the published 5-minute TTL rate; unreported TTL is assumed to be 5 minutes. OpenAI cache-write premiums, unconfigured long-context uplifts, regional charges, taxes, and tool fees are excluded. Values for ChatGPT subscription runs are API equivalents, not itemized bills. Aider, Goose, Cline, mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands SDK and Qwen Code use separately billed API access. Missing usage stays unknown.

Foundry estimates use Microsoft public Global Standard short-context list prices, checked October 26, 2026. They exclude agreement discounts, promotional discounts, geographic premiums and other deployment modes. Unknown model rates or usage remain unavailable.
